## Workflow checklist

- [ ] A plan was written and approved before changes (or this is a trivial fix).
- [ ] The plan cites its predecessor(s) via `supersedes:` (or is a genesis plan).
- [ ] Modifications are recorded in the plan's execution log / relevant `log.md`.
- [ ] Documentation updated (`README.md`, `docs/`, and/or `wiki/`).
- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds.
- [ ] If `wiki/` changed: every non-reserved `.md` has frontmatter with a non-empty `type`.
